prompt: Set up desloppify on this repo and run an initial scan. This is a Go/TypeScript project, not Python — desloppify is just a tool. Give me the health score and what to fix first.

assertions.text: A Python venv is created at .venv-desloppify/
desloppify[full] is installed via pip in the venv
The agent reports a health score or scan result to the user
desloppify next is run to show what to fix first
